title: Missing Authentication for Critical Function in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware could allow a…
description: CVE-2026-0480 is a vulnerability in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware where missing authentication for a critical function allows a malicious hypervisor to forge SEV-TIO guest request messages. This flaw could compromise the integrity and confidentiality of SEV-SNP guest memory. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6. No patch or remediation information is currently available.
